@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8180'
+title: 'ACPC-4: ClientModelExtension, the connection part (registration, connection state, `_` notifications and requests)'
+---
+## What
+ACPC-4, the first part. Add a general extension point to the client models. It has nothing that is specific to Testudo or SAH.
+
+Today `ModelClient.extensionHandlers` (`Sources/FoundationModelsACPClient/Model/ModelClient.swift:112`) gives only `SAHGraphQLSubscriptions.extensionHandlers`. `ClientSideConnection` reads `Client.extensionHandlers` one time, at connect (FoundationModelsACP `Connection/ClientSideConnection.swift:123`). Thus an extension must be registered before `connect`. `ExtensionHandlers` has public `registerMethod` and `registerNotification`, and no merge. Thus each extension registers into one shared `inout ExtensionHandlers`. No change to FoundationModelsACP is necessary.
+
+Make these changes:
+- [ ] New file `Sources/FoundationModelsACPClient/Model/ClientModelExtension.swift`: a public `@MainActor` protocol `ClientModelExtension`. It has:
+  - `associatedtype ConnectionState: AnyObject & Observable` (use `Void`-like `EmptyExtensionState` default when the extension has no connection state), and `func makeConnectionState() -> ConnectionState`.
+  - `func registerHandlers(into handlers: inout ExtensionHandlers, context: ClientModelExtensionContext<Self>)`. The context gives the extension its connection state on the main actor, the `connectionLogger`, and the session model for a `SessionId` (for a later task). Notification handlers run in the read loop, so they must hop to the main actor and return promptly. Request handlers can wait.
+  - `func didInitialize(_ response: InitializeResponse, state: ConnectionState)`: a hook, so an extension can read its `_meta` (for example `_meta.sah`). Default implementation: do nothing.
+  - `func didClose(state: ConnectionState)`: a hook for the close of the connection (for example to finish open streams). Default: do nothing.
+- [ ] `Model/ConnectionModel.swift`: `public func register(_ extension: some ClientModelExtension)`. An extension that is registered after `connect` takes effect at the next `connect`, and the model logs one diagnostic. Each `connect` makes a new connection state for each extension. `public func extensionState<E: ClientModelExtension>(_ type: E.Type) -> E.ConnectionState?` gives the state of the current connection.
+- [ ] `Model/ModelClient.swift`: `extensionHandlers` builds one `ExtensionHandlers` from each registered extension, in registration order, plus the `SAHGraphQLSubscriptions` handlers (they move onto the point in a later task). Two extensions that register the same method: the later one wins, and the model logs one diagnostic.
+- [ ] `Model/ConnectionModel+Initialize.swift` calls `didInitialize` of each extension after a successful `initialize`. The close path (`ConnectionModel.swift` near `graphQLSubscriptions?.closeAll()`) calls `didClose`.
+- [ ] DocC: one article or section in the target docs that tells how a host writes and registers an extension.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A test extension that is registered before `connect` gets its `_test/notify` notifications, and its observable connection state changes on the main actor.
+- [ ] A test extension serves a `_test/echo` request of the agent, and the agent gets the result.
+- [ ] `didInitialize` gets the `initialize` response; `didClose` runs one time when the connection closes.
+- [ ] A registration after `connect` has no effect on the open connection, logs one diagnostic, and takes effect at the next `connect`.
+- [ ] `extensionState(_:)` gives a new state after each `connect`.
+- [ ] The GraphQL tunnel tests stay green (the `SAHGraphQLSubscriptions` handlers still serve).
+- [ ] The public API has no SAH or Testudo name.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] New `Tests/FoundationModelsACPClientTests/Model/ClientModelExtensionTests.swift`: drive `ConnectionModel` over an in-memory transport with a scripted agent (see `ScriptedStubAgent.swift`, `TransportTestSupport.swift`) that sends `_test/notify` and calls `_test/echo`. Cover each acceptance criterion above, with `ObservationWait.swift` for the observable state.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter "ClientModelExtensionTests|SAHGraphQLClientConnectionTests"` → all pass. Then `swift test` → all pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #step1
\ No newline at end of file

+- [ ] New file `Sources/FoundationModelsACPClient/Model/ClientModelExtension.swift`:
+  - `public protocol ClientModelExtension: Sendable`. It is not main-actor isolated.
+  - `associatedtype ConnectionState: AnyObject` (a `@MainActor @Observable` class, or a `Sendable` class with a `Mutex` when the handlers need it off the main actor). `@MainActor func makeConnectionState() -> ConnectionState`.
+  - `nonisolated func registerHandlers(into handlers: inout ExtensionHandlers, context: ClientModelExtensionContext<Self>)`. The `Sendable` context gives `connectionLogger`, a `@MainActor` accessor of the connection state of this connection, and (for the next task) the `SessionModel` of a `SessionId`. A notification handler that changes main-actor state hops to the main actor. Document that a notification handler must return promptly, and that a request handler can wait.
+  - `@MainActor func didInitialize(_ response: InitializeResponse, state: ConnectionState)`, default: do nothing.
+  - `@MainActor func didClose(state: ConnectionState)`, default: do nothing.
